component.name: Mihon for Linux
component.summary: Read and manage manga from online sources

description.p: Mihon for Linux is a native GTK4 manga reader for the desktop. It keeps a library with categories, tracks what you have read, downloads chapters for offline reading, and browses online sources.

It loads unmodified Tachiyomi and Mihon extension APKs through a Kotlin bridge process, so the sources you already use keep working. Backups move in both directions with Mihon on Android through the .tachibk format.

ul.li: Library with categories, per-category sorting and filters, and batch actions
Paged and continuous webtoon reading, with two-page spread detection
Global search across every installed source at once
Import and export Mihon Android backups

description.p: This is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mihon or Tachiyomi projects, and it does not host or distribute any manga content.

ul.li: Paged and webtoon reader with zoom, tap zones, keyboard control and a per-series reading mode
Built-in sources, a local source, and Tachiyomi/Mihon APK extensions through a JVM bridge
Backup and restore compatible with Android Mihon, including tracker links
AniList and MyAnimeList tracking, scheduled library updates and an Upcoming view
